en-US.title: My Meeting App: Meeting Finder
en-US.subtitle: Recovery meetings near you
en-US.promoText: Find a meeting near you, and see how the people who go describe it, in a few plain words. Free, with no account, no ads and no tracking.
en-US.description:
Find a recovery meeting that fits, described by the people who go.

My Meeting App lists in-person, hybrid and online recovery meetings in the United States, AA and NA meetings, from the meeting lists that local service offices publish. Search a city or zip code, or let the app use your location to show the meetings near you, in a list or on a map. The list starts with what's on today, from now on, and you can filter by fellowship, day, time, meeting type and tags.

Descriptions, not ratings
After a meeting, people who went can pick up to six words from a fixed list, like "Welcoming", "Step study" or "Easy parking". The words come in groups: Format, Sharing, Crowd, Size, Feel and Practical. Each meeting shows how many people chose each word. You can change or remove your words at any time, and they count until you do. There are no stars, scores or written reviews, and tags never describe people.

Private by design
- No account. The app never asks for your name, email or phone number.
- Your exact location stays on your phone. A search sends only a point rounded to about 1 km, and we don't keep it.
- Your sobriety date and saved meetings stay on your phone.
- No ads, no tracking and no analytics.

Also in the app
- "Went to a meeting? Tag it": the meetings near you that started in the last 36 hours, so you can tag the one you went to.
- A size for each meeting, from "Small (under 15)" to "Very large (100+)". You pick one size when you tag.
- Online meetings happening now.
- If nothing is close by, search farther, up to 60 miles.
- Directions in Apple Maps.
- A sobriety counter with milestones.
- Saved meetings that work offline.
- "Delete all my tags" removes every tag this iPhone has added, at once.
- A Help button on every screen, with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and the SAMHSA National Helpline.

My Meeting App is not affiliated with or endorsed by Alcoholics Anonymous, A.A. World Services, Inc., Narcotics Anonymous or NA World Services, Inc. Meeting listings come from local service offices and may be out of date. The app isn't medical advice.
